annotations.title: Trace what happened to a receipt or invoice

description: Read a receipt/invoice/forwarded email/Gmail receipt/PDF's lineage timeline: missing, skipped, income-routed, deduped or duplicate-removed documents. Not Gmail scan-job status/progress/completion (running/queued/finished/stuck): use get_scan_status; a scan is not a document.

days.description: How many days back to search.

query.description: Merchant, sender, subject, invoice number, or phrase to search for, e.g. 'Blue Rocket', 'Driversnote', 'Uber receipt'.

receiptId.description: ExpenseBot receipt/invoice ID if known, e.g. IR-123, RO-abc, RR-456.

name: trace_document
